outcome: rate of effective ACS administrations (delivery ≤10 days after last dose)
rate of post-ACS births at/after 37+0 weeks
cohort: Participants were women who delivered after receiving antenatal corticosteroids at Charite Berlin, Germany, between 2014 and 2020.
finding: The study found an overall increase in the rate of effective antenatal corticosteroid administrations over time, particularly in cases of placental dysfunction and isthmocervical insufficiency.
